Lucid Plus 15W Magnetic Wireless Charger 10000mAh Powerbank with Stand

The Lucid Plus 15W Magnetic Wireless Charger 10000mAh Powerbank with stand for Airpods and iPhone is designed for users who demand speed, convenience, and portability in one premium charging solution. Built with a high-capacity 10000mAh / 37Wh battery, this powerbank ensures your iPhone, AirPods, and other compatible devices stay powered throughout the day—whether you are traveling, working, or commuting.

Featuring advanced 15W magnetic wireless charging, this powerbank aligns perfectly with MagSafe-compatible iPhones, delivering stable and efficient wireless output without cable clutter. The integrated foldable stand allows hands-free video calls, streaming, and browsing, making it ideal for both productivity and entertainment.

Fast & Intelligent Charging Performance

The Lucid Plus magnetic powerbank supports multiple fast-charging standards for wired and wireless devices. With Type-C input up to 18W and Type-C output up to 20W, it delivers rapid power replenishment for smartphones, tablets, and accessories. The USB-A output up to 22.5W ensures compatibility with a wide range of devices, including Android phones, Bluetooth headphones, and portable gadgets.

Wireless charging output options of 5W, 7.5W, 10W, and 15W make it suitable for iPhones, AirPods, and other Qi-enabled devices. Smart power management protects against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring safe and reliable performance every time.

Compact, Lightweight & Travel-Friendly

Weighing only 202g ± 10g and measuring 10.8 x 6.9 x 2.18 cm, this compact magnetic powerbank easily fits into your pocket, backpack, or handbag. Despite its slim form factor, the high-density lithium battery provides dependable all-day backup power without unnecessary bulk.

The sturdy magnetic attachment ensures a secure hold on compatible iPhones, while the anti-slip surface and durable build enhance long-term usability. Whether you are on a business trip, daily commute, or outdoor adventure, this powerbank is a dependable companion.

Ideal for iPhone, AirPods & More

Designed specifically for Apple users, the Lucid Plus magnetic works seamlessly with iPhone models that support magnetic and with AirPods that support wireless charging cases. It also supports wired charging for Android smartphones, power banks, fitness bands, and other USB-powered devices.

The built-in stand enhances usability, allowing you to charge and use your phone simultaneously in both portrait and landscape modes—perfect for FaceTime calls, watching videos, or following recipes while cooking.

Key Specifications

  • Product Name: Lucid Plus 15W Magnetic Wireless Charger Powerbank
  • Battery Capacity: 10000mAh / 37Wh
  • Input (Type-C): 5V/2.4A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A (18W)
  • Output (Type-C): 5V/3A, 9V/2.22A, 12V/1.67A (20W)
  • Output (USB-A): 5V/4.5A, 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A (22.5W)
  • Wireless Output: 5W / 7.5W / 10W / 15W
  • Weight: 202g ± 10g
  • Dimensions: 10.8 x 6.9 x 2.18 cm
  • Special Feature: Built-in Stand & Magnetic Alignment

If you are searching for a 10000mAh magnetic wireless powerbank for iPhone that combines fast charging, portability, and premium design, the Lucid Plus is the perfect choice. It delivers reliable performance, versatile charging options, and a user-friendly stand—making it one of the best magnetic wireless powerbanks in its category.
